top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications (26 TAC §746.605(13)(B)(i))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Admission Information Form 2935 has not been updated with the information for a child s reasonable accommodation or modifications.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Admission Information Form 2935 has not been updated with the information on a child s ability to swim without assistance.

top_violation_types.title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not informed the parents of their right.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor (26 TAC §HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regar)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three staff files hired after 09/01/2023 did not have a pre-employment affidavit available for review. Licensing staff provided a copy of form 2912 via email for staff to complete while Licensing was present.
